model_note: Two Logistic Regression variants trained: default weights (high accuracy) and balanced weights (higher sensitivity to Denied class). Primary reported metrics use default weights. ROC-AUC ~0.58 indicates limited discriminative power with only insurance_provider, payment_method, billed_amount and date features - expected given the synthetic nature of this dataset. denial_reason excluded to prevent target leakage.
class_imbalance_note: Dataset is imbalanced: 91.4% Paid / 8.6% Denied. A high accuracy score (~91%) can be achieved by predicting all claims as Paid. ROC-AUC is the more meaningful metric here.
